what: zumime: Media Type Detection from Bytes and File Names — zumime-package
title: zumime: Media Type Detection from Bytes and File Names — zumime-package
text: Tells file first bytes name, system library. Implements Web Hypertext Application Technology Working Group (WHATWG) Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) Sniffing Standard https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/ raw vectors paths. Reads inside containers tell 'Office' documents plain 'ZIP' archives, audio video 'MP4' files, 'Word' 'Excel' legacy 'Office' files, recognises data files 'R' users hold, files saved 'R', 'Parquet', 'SQLite' 'Stata' files. Every type parent hierarchy, extension table generated Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) media types registry 'Apache' 'httpd' type map answers name. One call reports answers, whether agree, whether file compressed, encrypted truncated.

title: zumime 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN submission. zumime tells file bytes name, dependency system library. mime_sniff() runs WHATWG MIME Sniffing Standard raw vector paths, supplied type, -sniff flag sniffing context, reports charset bytes declare line endings. Beyond standard, default context, container readers tell Office Open XML (macro-enabled, template slideshow variants), OpenDocument, EPUB, JAR APK plain ZIP; Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook installer files OLE2; MP4, M4A, M4V, QuickTime, 3GP, HEIC, HEIF AVIF brands; WebM Matroska; Ogg codecs. R’s RDS RData files recognised gzip, Parquet, Arrow, fst, qs2, SQLite, DuckDB, HDF5, NetCDF, Stata, SPSS SAS files, executables common archives. Structured text typed "probable": XML dialects root element namespace, JSON dialects top-level keys, NDJSON, line formats vCard, iCalendar, WebVTT PEM, scripts shebang. mime_type() types paths bytes name one C loop, says whether two agree, reports consumer needs opening file: type inside compression wrapper, encryption, completeness (complete = TRUE), line endings script’s interpreter. Directories, FIFOs, devices sockets typed inode/* without opened. mime_check() answers whether files one set allowed types bytes alone, answer mime_type(). mime_sniffer(), mime_push() mime_finish() sniff stream chunk chunk answer soon bytes decide type. type registry generated IANA’s media types registry Apache httpd’s mime.types: mime_types(), mime_guess(), mime_extensions(), mime_parent() mime_is(). Every type parent, ending application/octet-stream; zumime_info()$table_version dates sources. mime_parse() mime_format() parse serialise MIME type WHATWG standard defines . mime_register() mime_unregister() add type session, data rule matched C function rule called R. Either refines zumime sniffs default context. Optional help family, used asked: inner = "decompress" (zukomp), text = "family" (zucsv, zujson, zutoml) charset = "detect" (zuutf).
